# Introduction

This Trial Specifications Document (TSD) describes the design and technical details of the Management Strategy Evaluation (MSE) of North Pacific swordfish (*Xiphias gladius*; NSWO). It covers:

- operating models (@sec-operating-models);
- forward projections (@sec-forward-projections);
- performance metrics (@sec-performance-metrics);
- candidate management procedures and their tuning (@sec-cmps);
- presentation of the results (@sec-results).

The TSD is a **living document** that will be updated as the MSE progresses to reflect the current state of the analysis.

For more information on the North Pacific Swordfish MSE process see the project [homepage](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/).

## About the NSWO MSE

The NSWO MSE is built and maintained by [Blue Matter Science](https://bluematterscience.com) using the [openMSE](https://openMSE.com) framework.

The analysis is fully reproducible, and all materials are available in the associated [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Blue-Matter/wcpfcNSWO). The analysis scripts are in the `analysis` folder and are run in the order of their numbers.
